scope: Static standards and cross-client/build/contract audit of current working tree including uncommitted openGauss migration. No production changes or full P3C execution.
manualBasis: Official Alibaba GitBook/P3C rule definitions were inspected; Huangshan PDF is identified in official repository but was not text-extracted in this subtask. Final implementation must pin and map the chosen handbook edition.

sources.title: Official P3C-PMD implemented rules
sources.fact: 54 implemented rules, not the full handbook

sources.title: PMD7.29.0 stable release, candidate for later compatibility checks

findings.title: Java formatting does not yet follow selected Alibaba rules

evidence.detail: two-space member indentation
nonempty single-line if without braces

findings.impact: A default Google Java Format pass does not establish P3C conformance.
findings.recommendation: Separate a no-behavior formatting commit; evaluate four-space formatter mode and a Java21-capable brace rule, then review the selected handbook mapping.
findings.sourceRule: Alibaba official code-format mandatory four-space indentation; P3C NeedBraceRule

findings.title: Historical P3C engine cannot be treated as a Java21 compliance gate

evidence.detail: Java21 baseline
record syntax

findings.impact: Official p3c-pmd2.1.1 pins PMD6.15.0; modern source parsing and old custom AST rules must be validated before claiming coverage.
findings.recommendation: Pin manual version and rule mapping; use a Java21-capable PMD7 candidate after fixture validation, port/review custom rules rather than dependency-forcing. Parse failures fail the gate.
findings.notClaimed: No complete P3C engine run was executed.

findings.title: Web source is compressed into very long physical lines

evidence.detail: 6174-character line
11396-character line

findings.impact: Few physical lines hide multiple responsibilities and reduce review/locality; this is not evidence of runtime slowness.
findings.recommendation: Expand formatting separately, retain approved R3 tokens/visual behavior, then extract cohesive form/query/workflow modules where responsibilities differ.
findings.standardAttribution: Project engineering convention; Alibaba Java rules do not directly govern Vue/CSS.

findings.title: Native Index combines numerous workflows and UI builders

evidence.detail: login and session handling
home reads and shared page state
image uploads
root build

findings.impact: Adding device subscriptions here would couple permissions, timers and unrelated business drafts in a 1152-line file.
findings.recommendation: Preserve existing dispatch/visits/assist modules; add a session-scoped device module with a small interface and move existing workflow controllers/pages gradually.

findings.title: Several native reads can deliver successful old-session results after account change

evidence.detail: clearSession resets state but does not invalidate all ordinary read completions
loadHome awaits then directly assigns state
openRepair directly writes selected/events after awaits
decode protects 401 token clearing but does not reject successful old-session responses

findings.trigger: Start a slow read, sign out and sign in as another account before it succeeds.
findings.impact: Old data may repopulate shared state; no live reproduction was performed.
findings.existingProtection: DispatchController epoch/token guards and AI epoch checks already address their own paths.
findings.recommendation: Use a shared session epoch/cancel seam for reads, errors and device callbacks; add a public-interface race regression before implementation.

findings.title: No repository gate verifies the full contract-generation chain

evidence.detail: maintenance source emits OpenAPI JSON
build generates TS from existing OpenAPI JSON only
ArkTS generator reads existing OpenAPI JSON

findings.impact: A DSL change without regenerating JSON can leave both clients building against stale types.
findings.recommendation: Document one maintenance source; gate DSL -> OpenAPI -> TS/ArkTS regeneration and git diff; test Java wire shapes and API1.1 compatibility before adding optional device endpoints.

findings.title: P3C/formatting/contract drift checks are not declared in current build

evidence.detail: only Spring Boot build plugin declared
test/build scripts exist, no lint/format check script

findings.impact: Current passing behavior tests do not establish coding-standard conformance.
findings.recommendation: Introduce versioned rule/config checks gradually, baseline existing debt and reject new findings on changed code; keep tests separate from style report.
findings.notClaimed: Remote branch-protection configuration was not inspected; absence of local .github is not proof of all remote CI settings.

findings.title: Native controller tests depend on source text rewriting

evidence.detail: imports removed by regex before constructing controller with new Function

findings.impact: A valid import/refactor can break the harness without changing behavior; this does not invalidate its existing behavior coverage.
findings.recommendation: Keep existing guards and tests during extraction; favor platform-free computation/provider interfaces and a supported test compilation path for new device math, plus SDK/physical-device verification for adapters.

gatePlan: Pin handbook source/version/commit and selected rules; distinguish mandatory/recommended/reference and project-specific rules.
Prove Java21 record/text-block/pattern fixtures parse with selected engine. Old P3C custom rules require an explicit mapping or migration, not blind PMD7 substitution.
Generate one current baseline with rule IDs, tool versions, paths, fingerprints and justified scoped suppressions; parse/infrastructure errors never count as zero violations.
Use a separate formatting commit; reject added violations in changed code and gradually remove old debt. Generated artifacts and third-party license files have dedicated exclusions.
Gate contract regeneration and Java HTTP compatibility tests; new device features are additive/optional and must preserve existing API1.1 fields, roles, versions, errors and idempotency.
Run native adapter/device verification separately from pure algorithm helpers; hardware accuracy/energy results cannot be inferred from simulator builds.
notAlibabaMandates: Mandatory interface+Impl for every internal class
Treating Map DTOs as a violation without a mapped rule
Applying Java source-format rules verbatim to Vue/ArkTS/CSS
